says: The refused handshake state keeps no since, so a socket that closes after a refused hello writes its connect closed row with ms 0 instead of how long the dial lived.
proof: Scratch walk (scratchpad p18/walk.ts refused, node 26, p18s1 worktree at 3555b4b3c): challenge at 1000, bad_signature answer, then socket_closed code 1000 at about 5020 printed the row {"_tag":"connect","dial":1,"result":"closed","ms":0,"code":1000}; closedIn at WindowMachine.ts:619 reads since only when the state has it, and Handshake.ts declares refused as {dial, reason, ms}.
cost: Connect rows after a refusal report a zero-length dial, which skews any duration read from them; the fix is one field kept on refused.
